import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Vector;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        run();
    }

    public static void run() {
        Vector<Long> degs = new Vector<>();
        degs.add(1L);
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            degs.add(degs.get(i - 1) * 10 + 1);
        }
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(rec(n, 18, degs));
    }

    public static long rec(long cur, int d, Vector<Long> degs) {
        cur = Math.abs(cur);
        if (cur % degs.get(d) == 0) {
            return cur / degs.get(d) * d;
        }
        long k = cur / degs.get(d);
        long temp1 = (k * d + rec(cur - k * degs.get(d), d - 1, degs));
        long temp2 = ((k + 1) * d + rec((k + 1) * degs.get(d) - cur, d - 1, degs));
        return Math.min(temp1, temp2);
    }
}
